fields.meta_title: RFP Form Builder for Vendor Proposals | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an RFP form that takes vendor proposals until a set deadline, answers vendor questions for every bidder and scores each response.
fields.h1: Build an RFP Form That Collects and Scores Proposals
fields.hero_description: Describe the project and how your panel will judge it. Emergent builds the RFP form vendors respond through, closes it at your deadline and gives each evaluator a score sheet.
fields.features_heading: What the RFP Document Leaves to You
fields.features_subheading: A template gives vendors the headings to write under. Collecting their answers still falls to email threads and a spreadsheet.
fields.feature_1:
Arrival time on every upload

Record the minute each proposal arrives and close the form at the hour you set. A late vendor finds a closed page, and your file shows exactly when every response came in.
fields.feature_2:
One question log, one addendum

Collect vendor questions in a single list until the question deadline. Publish the answers as one addendum that reaches every registered vendor, with the asker's name taken out.
fields.feature_3:
The same fields for every bidder

Ask each vendor for price, staffing and timeline in fixed fields, not a loose PDF. Responses line up in one table, and your panel compares answers without hunting through pages.
fields.feature_4:
Weighted scoring for the panel

Give each criterion its points before the RFP goes out. Evaluators score in their own view, the app adds up the totals, and a score far from the rest waits for a written note.
fields.feature_5:
Requests from the department

Let a department ask procurement for an RFP with its scope and a needed-by date. Procurement gets an email with the request attached and opens the solicitation as a draft.
fields.feature_6:
Every bid in your own repository

Export the full code to your GitHub on paid plans when you want it. Procurement keeps the vendor list, each response and every score in its own codebase, ready for the next round.
fields.why_title: Why Build RFP Forms With Emergent?
fields.why_description: A Word template tells vendors what to write. It cannot stop a late upload or put six bids in the same columns.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Buyers Run Their RFPs
fields.tab_content_1:
Proposals in by 2:00 p.m., or not at all

Harlow City's public works department is hiring an engineering firm to design the Mill Road bridge repair. Firms upload a proposal and a price sheet, each stamped with its arrival time. The form closes at 2:00 p.m. on the due date. Twelve proposals made it in. A firm that tried at 2:03 p.m. was too late.
fields.tab_content_2:
17 vendor questions, answered for every bidder at once

Pine Valley School District is buying 1,200 classroom laptops. Vendors send questions through a form until the question deadline, and purchasing reads them in one list. All 17 questions from 6 vendors are answered in Addendum 1. The app emails it to every registered vendor with the asking vendor's name removed.
fields.tab_content_3:
When one evaluator disagrees, the panel sees why

Three people at Northwind Logistics score each warehouse software proposal out of 100, with fit worth 40 points. On Vendor C's fit, two evaluators gave 31 and 33 while Raj Mehta gave 18. Any score more than 10 points from both others holds the total until its evaluator writes a note. Vendor C's total is on hold.
fields.tab_content_4:
Room rates from six hotels, lowest one marked

The Northfield Dental Association needs 300 rooms a night for three nights at its annual meeting. Its venue RFP went to 8 hotels, each answering in the same fields. Six replied before the deadline. The bids sit in one table, and the Lakeshore Grand's $189 rate is marked as the lowest.

fields.howto_title: How to Make an RFP Form
fields.howto_description: Write the evaluation plan before the form. The fields vendors fill in should be the ones your panel scores.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Write the due date as a time
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Ask every vendor the same questions
fields.howto_step_1_des: List the criteria your panel will score and give each one a point value, such as 40 for fit and 35 for cost. Publish the weights in the RFP itself. Vendors write sharper proposals when they can see what earns points.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Pick a date and an exact hour, such as 2:00 p.m. Central, and state that late proposals will not be opened. Close vendor questions earlier, giving every bidder the answers before the writing starts.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Turn the scope into fields: price, staffing, timeline, references, and an upload for the full proposal. Fixed fields make bids comparable line by line. Keep one open text box for anything the fields miss.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide who answers vendor questions and how the answers go out. Publish one addendum to every registered vendor with no vendor named. A bidder who asked privately should never hold facts the others lack.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste the criteria, the deadline, the fields, and the question rules into one prompt. Emergent builds the response form, the question log and a score sheet for each evaluator. Change any part later by asking in a sentence.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Give evaluators the proposals and their own score sheet, and hide the other scores until scoring closes. Have the app email procurement when the form closes, with a count of the responses received.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it as a vendor would
fields.howto_step_7_des: Submit a test response from a phone, upload a large PDF and ask a test question. Confirm the arrival time is stamped and the form closes on schedule. Delete the test response before the RFP goes public.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is vendor-made RFP templates (Samsara, Riskonnect, Manhattan Associates, Optimizely, Qualifacts, Existek), one city's sample PDF and a how-to-write guide, and the AI Overview lists the sections an RFP should hold. Every result stops at the document. None of them handles what happens once the RFP goes out: proposals arriving before a fixed deadline, vendor questions answered for everyone at once, a panel scoring against weighted criteria, and bids that arrive in comparable fields. This page answers the People Also Ask questions on what an RFP is, who writes it, cost, timing and legal weight, then shows four issuers whose RFP form runs the response side: a city closing engineering proposals at 2:00 p.m., a school district answering vendor questions in one addendum, a logistics company scoring warehouse software with three evaluators, and an association comparing hotel bids for its annual meeting.
tab_stories: Harlow City's public works department collects engineering design proposals through a form that stamps each upload with its arrival time and locks at 2:00 p.m. on the due date, so the 12 on-time proposals are opened and a 13th tried at 2:03 p.m. never gets in.

Pine Valley School District takes vendor questions on its classroom laptop RFP through a form until the question deadline, then answers all 17 questions from 6 vendors in Addendum 1, which goes to every registered vendor with vendor names removed.

Northwind Logistics has three evaluators score four warehouse software proposals against fit at 40 points, cost at 35 and support at 25, and when one evaluator scores a vendor far below the other two, the app asks that evaluator for a written note before the totals are final.

The Midwest Dental Association sends a venue RFP to 8 hotels for its three-night annual meeting, each hotel enters its room rate, room block and meeting space in the same fields, and 6 replies land in one table where the lowest rate is marked.

claims_to_source: Requests for proposals are used to communicate requirements to prospective contractors and solicit proposals, and at minimum describe the requirement, the anticipated terms, the information the proposal must contain and the evaluation factors with their relative importance

After a federal solicitation is released, the contracting officer is the focal point of exchanges with potential offerors, and specific information disclosed to one potential offeror that is needed to prepare proposals must be made available to all

Under the Uniform Guidance, recipients of federal awards use formal procurement (sealed bids or proposals) above the simplified acquisition threshold, and requests for proposals require public notice and must identify all evaluation factors and their relative importance
An offer is a response to a solicitation that, if accepted, would bind the offeror to perform the resulting contract; responses to requests for proposals are offers called proposals
